questions.question: Compare NTFS,FAT32,exFAT based on its features.
questions.solution_html:
• A file system is a method used by an operating system to organize, store, retrieve, and
  • manage files on a storage device, enabling efficient access to data by maintaining a
  • structured hierarchy of files and directories along with metadata for each file.
  • Types : NTFS supports large file sizes, file permissions, encryption, and journaling for
  • security and reliability; FAT32 is compatible with most devices but limited to 4GB file
  • size and lacks advanced features; exFAT combines FAT32’s compatibility with support
  • for larger file sizes and is optimized for flash drives but lacks NTFS’s security features.

questions.question: Write any two data recovery Softwares and explain it briefly.
questions.solution_html:
• Data recovery is the process of restoring lost, deleted, corrupted, or inaccessible data
  • from storage devices such as hard drives, SSDs, USB drives, or memory cards using
  • specialized software or techniques to make the data usable again.
  • Tools : Recuva: A user-friendly Windows tool for recovering deleted files with quick and
  • deep scans, supporting common file types and FAT, exFAT, and NTFS file systems.
  • Recoverit: A versatile data recovery software capable of restoring lost files from various
  • devices with advanced scanning and supported formats. EaseUS Data Recovery: A
  • comprehensive recovery program that supports multiple file types and devices, featuring
  • quick scanning and preview options. Disk Drill: A powerful and user-friendly tool that
  • recovers lost data from various file systems and devices with advanced scanning
  • algorithms. R-Studio: An advanced recovery software favored by IT professionals for
  • recovering data from complex file systems and damaged RAID configurations. PhotoRec
  • An open-source data recovery tool focusing on recovering lost files from damaged or
  • formatted storage, particularly effective for photos. Pandora Recovery: Offers simple
  • and effective file recovery on Windows with a focus on deleted file recovery and file
  • preview capabilities.
  • (Define data recovery : (1 Marks) , Explain any 2 tools : (4 marks) each , Example of
  • two types :(0.5 marks) each )
